text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends the prohibition of parking at all times on the north side of Cadbury Court between Chancery Lane and around the Cadbury Court cul-de-sac. Currently, parking is prohibited from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on both sides of this street.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on both sides of Cadbury Court, between Chancery Lane and the west end of Cadbury Court. 2. Prohibited parking at all times on the north side of Cadbury Court, between Chancery Lane and the west end of Cadbury Court. 3. Prohibited parking from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of Cadbury Court, between Chancery Lane and a point 114 metres west. 4. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Cadbury Court, between a point 114 metres west of Chancery Lane and the west end of Cadbury Court.
